entries.12bf6541c3e852d2: As its basic management policy, the company states that it aims to become a global trading company that is valued by customers, based on customer-focused sales activities, proposing environmentally friendly products. Its medium-term management strategy consists of three elements: improving profitability, expanding overseas markets, and establishing sustainability efforts and a high-quality system. For improving profitability, the company aims to provide high value-added products through technology-oriented sales led by technical consultants and manufacturing through fabless production, and it will pursue a focus on fine chemicals (precision chemicals) and expansion of its sales base in Southeast Asia. For expanding overseas markets, the company is focusing on sales through overseas bases centered on Southeast Asia and on handling imported products.

It is characterized by technology-oriented sales, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,521 million. In addition to sales by the company, it also conducts purchasing and sales through overseas subsidiaries.
entries.84c21f49e26c8d72: Its strength is the technology-oriented sales that it has continued since its founding. Led by technical consultants, including setting up a testing laboratory within the company, it provides customer needs and technical information to manufacturers, collaborates with manufacturers on developing new products, and provides specialized product information and technical services to customers, carrying out sales activities that go beyond mere distribution. Although it is a trading company, it also carries out manufacturing through fabless production, and in the Construction Materials Business its subsidiary KYOWA Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing wooden products.
